metadata.parameter_policy: Coils: all bundled QA Fourier/normalized-current DOFs. Birth: independent XYZ [m] and pitch per particle; shared ln(E/4000eV), and shared gyrophase [rad] for Lorentz. Joint: both groups. Fixed reference wall and error scales. No VMEC/Boozer DOFs.

birth_setup.classifier: Periodic cubic in phi, linear in R/Z; original QA births include the angular seam

metadata.forward_policy: Native I; ESSOS Diffrax PI (.4,.3); identical physical embedded-error budgets
metadata.reverse_policy: Native accepted steps with frozen times, segment length 16, accepted capacity 2048; Diffrax default RecursiveCheckpointAdjoint
metadata.timing_scope: Public jax.vjp of jitted cost for forward linearization (includes host dispatch); per-objective jitted VJP reuses residuals and takes a dynamic one-hot cotangent
metadata.memory_scope: Compiled pullback arguments + outputs + temporaries - aliases, not process RSS
metadata.nonfinite_policy: Preserve failed cases; nonfinite numbers are null and finiteness/status flags identify them
metadata.objective_adaptation: Collisionless SI GC/Lorentz reconstruction; branch formulas and 1e-12 normalization constants preserved; heat is a proxy, not area-resolved flux
